My first coherent memory is from when I was about 12 months old. I was in the playpen playing with a doll, like you do, when my mom came out of the shower. Without her glasses, and with her hair wrapped in a towel.

I know it might seem implausible to remember something from that early, but as an adolescent I recounted this story to my mother, who confirmed it.
